images.content: a two-page opening, each side showing a crowned/allegorical figure holding a scroll or tablet inscribed with short pseudo-writing (left tablet ~3 short lines, e.g. 'CFCYFCTOT / EOLL18YEM / GAECEL9O' as read casually from the image, NOT a careful transcription; right tablet ~3 lines of continuous capitals, e.g. 'ISYRLAEDET REUZCEIHS / SYFEKS7ERY... / ET(?)ALLAXCVUOMH6O', plus a third short inscribed label near a bare tree on the right page). This does NOT obviously match the spec's 6-line/228-character 'S. d. d. occo. x.' abbreviation-style transcription in specs/untersberg-code.json -- treat as an UNCONFIRMED candidate for 'the cave inscription' page, not a match, pending a careful re-check against Schmeh's own scienceblogs.de image.
